title: Movement demo: playable hero with all movement states (run/leap+dash/glide/flight)
description: Bootstrap the Godot 4.6 project and build a playable movement demo where the hero exercises EVERY movement verb so we can test game feel. This is a movement test, not a progression test: all elements are pre-unlocked from the start. Build per .claude/skills/godot-game-dev (node FSM EstadoBase->MoveState/JumpState/GlideState/FlightState, CharacterBody2D with gravity + coyote time + jump buffering, collision Layers/Masks, project hygiene) and honor the feel intent in .claude/skills/game-design and docs/DECISIONES-DISENO.md. Deliver: project.godot with an InputMap (move_left/move_right/jump/dash/glide/fly); a Player scene (CharacterBody2D) with a StateMachine and the four movement states; abilities pre-set to {fire,ice,electricity}=true so leap+dash (Fire), glide (Ice), and free 8-direction flight (Electricity) are all immediately usable; a test level (TileMapLayer or StaticBody2D platforms) with gaps, ledges, walls and a tall vertical shaft so every verb has something to exercise; a camera that follows the player; an on-screen debug label showing the current FSM state name; a main scene set as the run target. Tests-first with GUT for the pure FSM transition logic (Move->Jump on jump-from-floor; air + glide-input -> Glide; flight unlocked + fly-input -> Flight; land -> Move; ability gating: without electricity, fly-input does NOT enter Flight). Verify the project imports and loads without script/scene errors by running the Godot console binary headless. Engine binary paths and the exact GUT command are in .claude/agents/project-context.md.
acceptance_criteria: The repo contains a valid Godot 4.6 project (project.godot) with an InputMap covering move_left, move_right, jump, dash, glide, fly; the project imports and loads headless with zero script/scene parse errors.

A Player (CharacterBody2D) scene exists with a node-based StateMachine and the four states MoveState, JumpState (leap + air dash), GlideState, FlightState, following the godot-game-dev FSM pattern (no boolean-flag soup).

All movement abilities are pre-unlocked in the demo so running, jumping, dashing, gliding, and free 8-directional flight are all playable immediately; a camera follows the player and an on-screen label shows the active state name.
A test level provides gaps, ledges, walls, and a tall vertical shaft so each movement verb is exercisable; a designated main scene launches the demo.
GUT unit tests cover the FSM transition rules including ability gating (no electricity => no Flight), and the headless GUT suite exits 0 (all pass).
Movement feel honors docs/DECISIONES-DISENO.md and the game-design skill: coyote time + jump buffering present; deterministic, fair movement.

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body: Developer built the movement demo tests-first (commits fbb3cac/a491ad0/730a159/9811a49/45c6309). Reviewer BLOCKed on a HIGH (jump buffering consumed before coyote check) + 2 MED. Developer fixed all (peek-then-consume jump buffer with load-bearing regression test; FlightState floor-exit + one-shot suppress_jump_impulse; air-dash tests; mutually-exclusive exits) in commit f4743ed. Orchestrator independently verified 24/24 GUT pass exit 0 + clean headless run, and committed the fix (dev sandbox blocked commit). Reviewer re-reviewed f4743ed and gave ACCEPT (no new defects). AC met. Done.
